source_snapshot.format: gzip UTF-8 JSON; documents[].html_utf8 preserves exact source bytes after UTF-8 re-encoding

shared_transport.encoding: UTF-8; percent-encode base64 plus as %2B in form transport
shared_transport.mutation_idempotency_key: not_documented; create replay may duplicate; update by ID is documented but is not an unknown-create reconciliation mechanism

requiredness_policy.null: No explicit required/optional guarantee on the individual page; do not invent requiredness from an example or parameter name.
requiredness_policy.false: Explicit optional/default or omission behavior documented.
requiredness_policy.true: Reserved for an explicit requirement; none promoted merely from an unmarked identifier.

current_code_review.scope: read-only server/web TypeScript/TSX exact-name/transport searches plus listed candidates; no application/DB/account tests

anchors.boundary: order buyer fields are per-order snapshots; no reviewed stable CRM identity
delivery sidecar for one order; not a CRM profile/address master
order-linked threads/notes with open/closed; not customer status groups
communications REST routes; not Base CRM wire methods
commerce order statuses; not CRM client statuses
own B2B accounts are candidates only; not evidence of Base Connect integer contractor IDs
messages UI exists; no reviewed dedicated client CRM UI
per-order delivery changes; not independent client CRUD

implementation_needed: stable tenant-scoped CRM identity and Base integer-ID mapping
independent invoice/delivery/contact/notes/star data; patch semantics preserving omitted fields
CRM custom field values/files and optional Base Connect contractor linkage
separate client status/group IDs, main/primary markers and defaults
atomic client migration on status delete; group migration on group delete
forbid removal of primary status/main group; keep order status vocabulary separate
CRM-specific field definitions, editor metadata and typed value serialization
file title/base64 upload versus title/URL readback; removal by empty string
resolve collection-shape conflict using an authorized observation or official clarification

open_contract_issues.issue: ExtraFields prose mentions include_custom_extra_fields in getCrmClients; its own input table has no such argument and output explicitly excludes custom fields.
open_contract_issues.decision: Only getCrmClientData has a documented include flag; do not silently add it to the list method.

open_contract_issues.issue: extra_fields prose describes an ID-keyed collection; example JSON is an array of field objects with extra_field_id.
open_contract_issues.decision: Preserve both; exact wire shape remains unresolved.

open_contract_issues.issue: custom_extra_fields is declared array, while description/example uses ID keys and add example is an object.
open_contract_issues.decision: Do not coerce to a positional list; confirm keyed JSON shape separately.

open_contract_issues.issue: No global requiredness marker, null semantics, specific error taxonomy or HTTP error mapping.
open_contract_issues.decision: Null requiredness is deliberate; later compatibility tests must settle missing/invalid input rather than inventing behavior.

open_contract_issues.issue: No documented default page, sort order, total count, terminal-page rule or cross-page consistency.
open_contract_issues.decision: Only explicit page size100/from1 is normative.

methods.semantics_pl: crm_client_id >0 aktualizuje istniejącego klienta; 0 lub pominięcie tworzy nowego. Przy aktualizacji zmieniają się tylko przekazane pola.
proposed_acceptance: create then detail; update only supplied field; unspecified existing fields survive
0/omitted ID create; positive ID targets update; unknown positive ID outcome remains an open contract
NIP normalization; custom field empty-string clear; file write/read shape differs; lost ACK never blindly recreate

methods.semantics_pl: Usuwa klienta CRM; dotychczasowe zamówienia pozostają nienaruszone.
proposed_acceptance: read target then delete and inspect result; all pre-existing orders remain unchanged
missing/already-deleted ID outcome needs official account observation

methods.semantics_pl: Zwraca pojedynczego klienta, w tym notes; custom_extra_fields tylko przy include_custom_extra_fields=true.
proposed_acceptance: detail includes notes; optional false default omits custom fields, true includes them
file custom field returns title/url, not the uploaded base64 payload

methods.semantics_pl: Zwraca definicje dodatkowych pól CRM, nie wartości przypisane klientowi.
proposed_acceptance: all seven editor types represented; options only documented for select/checkbox/radio
resolve array-versus-keyed prose conflict before freezing serializer

methods.semantics_pl: Lista filtrowana; szczegóły bez notes i custom_extra_fields. Pełne dane pobiera się osobno.
proposed_acceptance: more than100 clients, explicit page1/page2, exactID/status versus partial text filters
list excludes notes/custom fields; test empty and last-page behavior without inventing a total/has_more

methods.semantics_pl: Tworzy lub aktualizuje status według status_id; bez group_id nowy trafia do głównej grupy, istniejący zachowuje grupę.
proposed_acceptance: create default main-group status; update without group_id preserves assignment
verify requiredness/name/color omission independently; readback via getCrmClientStatuses

methods.semantics_pl: Tworzy grupę albo aktualizuje wskazaną przez group_id; organizuje statusy w panelu.
proposed_acceptance: create/rename and readback via groups; varchar15 boundary; existing group remains stable

methods.semantics_pl: Przenosi wszystkich klientów usuwanego statusu do target_status_id; statusu głównego nie wolno usuwać.
proposed_acceptance: all clients migrate to different target; primary status refuses deletion
same target/source invalid; missing target/error code not documented

methods.semantics_pl: Przenosi statusy usuwanej grupy do grupy głównej; grupa główna nie podlega usunięciu.
proposed_acceptance: statuses move to main group, without deleting clients/statuses; main group refuses deletion

methods.semantics_pl: Lista grup; is_main_group ma wartości całkowite 0/1.
proposed_acceptance: read groups and integer0/1 main marker; no undocumented paging or stable ordering assumption

methods.semantics_pl: Lista statusów CRM użytkownika; id jest identyfikatorem statusu, is_primary ma wartości 0/1.
proposed_acceptance: read id/name/color/group_id/integer primary marker; resolve group ID through groups, not order-status IDs

boundary: Public documentation contract inventory only. No CRM implementation acceptance, account API calls, runtime modification, or scope-v2 mutation.
